coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: The output matches one of five ground-truth variable categories at a broad level: comparing reference MD, subsampled trajectories, and MDGEN-generated trajectories. It does not match the two specified constants or the two specified dependent variables.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The trajectory resolutions differ: the required comparison uses 100 fs reference data, 10 ps subsampling, and 10 ps-to-100 fs upsampling. The output omits pooling 30k test-peptide frames and fixed training/inference settings (256-residue crops, every-40-frame selection, full-protein inference). It replaces torsion-angle cosine autocorrelation over 100 fs–100 ps and its negative log-timescale derivative with primarily PSD-based metrics; autocorrelation time alone does not match the required autocorrelation function.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: No conclusion was provided, so the expected conclusion is not semantically matched.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: The output does not state that MDGEN recovers sub-ps oscillations, matches ground-truth autocorrelation curves, and exhibits non-monotonic dynamic content, whereas subsampled trajectories lack these features.
